Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 8 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Naira - 10 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Hema - 40 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Vimla - 62 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "What lovely weather!"

[Nikhil peeks out from behind the door.]

Nikhil (happily): "Okay, Mom."

[Nikhil nods.]

Hema (surprised): "This is amazing!"

[Snow begins to fall.]

Nikhil (surprised): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Nikhil: "That was fun!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Naira and Hema stand near him.]

Hema: "Let's begin."

[Nikhil puts on his school uniform.]

Nikhil: "Exactly right."

[Nikhil combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Naira: "Hey, look at that!"

[Nikhil puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Nikhil (surprised): "Exactly right."

[Naira applies kajal to her eyes.]

Hema: "Naira, listen!"

[Naira puts on red lipstick.]

Naira: "That's great!"

[Naira puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Nikhil (happily): "That was such a fun day!"
